propositions: Container tickets with no declared file_impact fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation, requiring re-review on every unrelated commit

Container plan-review attestations should inherit the union of non-closed direct children's file_impact, with a poison rule: if any non-closed child has empty file_impact, inheritance does not apply and the set remains empty (whole-HEAD fallback)
Closed children should neither contribute files to the inherited union nor poison it, as their work is delivered
P9 (file_impact_coverage) should auto-pass containers with effective inheritance and surface an advisory (non-blocking) naming children with empty file_impact when inheritance is poisoned
A child editing its file_impact after container review should invalidate the container's attestation via material_fingerprint pin drift, forcing recomputation
